//! Exact persistence codec and automatic-versus-restored backing contracts.
use std::webgpu::{SurfaceQualityFacts, SurfaceBackingExtent}
use ingot::policy::{SharpBacking, BackingRequest, MandelbrotViewState, SurfaceStateEnvelope, initial_state}
use ingot::url::{DecodedPersistedView, PersistedBounds, PersistedView, QuadWordBits,
    URL_ENCODED_LEN, F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS, F32_ONE_BITS, F32_RES_512_BITS,
    F32_RES_1024_BITS, is_valid_persisted_view, roundtrip_persisted_view,
    roundtrip_with_mutated_byte}

#[test]
fn sharp_backing_preserves_restored_url_res_across_different_viewport_and_resize() {
    let facts_512 = SurfaceQualityFacts {
        css_width: 512.0,
        css_height: 512.0,
        device_pixel_ratio: 1.0,
        declared_width: 2048.0,
        declared_height: 2048.0,
        max_texture_dimension_2d: 2048.0,
        coarse_pointer: false,
        gpu_available: true,
    }
    let facts_640 = SurfaceQualityFacts {
        css_width: 640.0,
        css_height: 640.0,
        device_pixel_ratio: 1.0,
        declared_width: 2048.0,
        declared_height: 2048.0,
        max_texture_dimension_2d: 2048.0,
        coarse_pointer: false,
        gpu_available: true,
    }
    let uninitialized: SurfaceStateEnvelope = initial_state()
    assert(uninitialized.state.camera.res == 512.0)
    let cold_512: SurfaceBackingExtent = SharpBacking::choose(facts_512, uninitialized)
    assert(cold_512.width == 512.0)
    assert(cold_512.height == 512.0)

    let cold_640: SurfaceBackingExtent = SharpBacking::choose(facts_640, uninitialized)
    assert(cold_640.width == 640.0)
    assert(cold_640.height == 640.0)

    let mut restored_view: MandelbrotViewState = uninitialized.state
    restored_view.camera.res = 1024.0
    restored_view.backing = BackingRequest::fixed(1024.0)
    let restored = SurfaceStateEnvelope { state: restored_view }
    let restored_on_512: SurfaceBackingExtent = SharpBacking::choose(facts_512, restored)
    assert(restored_on_512.width == 1024.0)
    assert(restored_on_512.height == 1024.0)

    let restored_after_resize_640: SurfaceBackingExtent = SharpBacking::choose(facts_640, restored)
    assert(restored_after_resize_640.width == 1024.0)
    assert(restored_after_resize_640.height == 1024.0)
}

#[test]
fn url_persisted_view_roundtrips_deep_zoom_limbs_and_signed_zero() {
    let bounds = PersistedBounds {
        center_x_min_bits: 0xc0200000,
        center_x_max_bits: 0x3f800000,
        center_y_min_bits: 0xbfc00000,
        center_y_max_bits: 0x3fc00000,
        zoom_min_bits: 0x129e74d2,
        zoom_max_bits: 0x40400000,
    }
    let fallback = PersistedView {
        center_x: QuadWordBits {
            w0: 0xbf960edd,
            w1: 0xb214a970,
            w2: 0x253e3631,
            w3: 0x17a3a810,
        },
        center_y: QuadWordBits {
            w0: 0x3e97762f,
            w1: 0xb1928121,
            w2: 0xa57b5246,
            w3: 0x9891c941,
        },
        zoom_bits: 0x33271301,
        res_bits: F32_RES_512_BITS,
        antialias_bits: F32_ONE_BITS,
    }
    let mut persisted: PersistedView = fallback
    persisted.res_bits = F32_RES_1024_BITS
    persisted.center_y.w3 = F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS
    persisted.antialias_bits = F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS
    assert(persisted.center_y.w3 == F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS)
    assert(persisted.center_y.w3 != 0)
    assert(persisted.encoded_byte(67) == 56) // '8' from "80000000"
    assert(is_valid_persisted_view(persisted, bounds))

    let decoded: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(persisted, fallback, bounds)
    assert(decoded.valid)
    let decoded_view: PersistedView = decoded.view
    assert(decoded_view == persisted)
    assert(decoded_view.center_y.w3 == F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS)
    assert(decoded_view.antialias_bits == F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS)

    // Verify +0.0 (00000000) and -0.0 (80000000) remain distinct bit patterns after roundtrip
    let mut pos_zero_view: PersistedView = persisted
    pos_zero_view.center_y.w3 = 0
    let pos_decoded: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(pos_zero_view, fallback, bounds)
    assert(pos_decoded.valid)
    let pos_view: PersistedView = pos_decoded.view
    assert(pos_view == pos_zero_view)
    assert(pos_view != decoded_view)

    // Verify uppercase hex character ('B' = 66 at offset 4) decodes identically to canonical lowercase
    let upper_decoded: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_with_mutated_byte(
        persisted,
        4,
        66,
        URL_ENCODED_LEN,
        fallback,
        bounds,
    )
    assert(upper_decoded.valid)
    let upper_view: PersistedView = upper_decoded.view
    assert(upper_view == persisted)
}

fn url_persisted_view_rejects_malformed_nonfinite_and_out_of_range_atomically() {
    let bounds = PersistedBounds {
        center_x_min_bits: 0xc0200000,
        center_x_max_bits: 0x3f800000,
        center_y_min_bits: 0xbfc00000,
        center_y_max_bits: 0x3fc00000,
        zoom_min_bits: 0x129e74d2,
        zoom_max_bits: 0x40400000,
    }
    let fallback = PersistedView {
        center_x: QuadWordBits {
            w0: 0xbf960edd,
            w1: 0xb214a970,
            w2: 0x253e3631,
            w3: 0x17a3a810,
        },
        center_y: QuadWordBits {
            w0: 0x3e97762f,
            w1: 0xb1928121,
            w2: 0xa57b5246,
            w3: 0x9891c941,
        },
        zoom_bits: 0x33271301,
        res_bits: F32_RES_512_BITS,
        antialias_bits: F32_ONE_BITS,
    }
    assert(is_valid_persisted_view(fallback, bounds))

    // 1. Wrong version (#v2:)
    let r1: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_with_mutated_byte(
        fallback,
        2,
        50,
        URL_ENCODED_LEN,
        fallback,
        bounds,
    )
    assert(!r1.valid)
    let v1: PersistedView = r1.view
    assert(v1 == fallback)

    // 2. Malformed hex character ('g' = 103)
    let r2: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_with_mutated_byte(
        fallback,
        10,
        103,
        URL_ENCODED_LEN,
        fallback,
        bounds,
    )
    assert(!r2.valid)
    let v2: PersistedView = r2.view
    assert(v2 == fallback)

    // 3. Truncated length (101 instead of 102)
    let r3: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_with_mutated_byte(
        fallback,
        200,
        0,
        101,
        fallback,
        bounds,
    )
    assert(!r3.valid)
    let v3: PersistedView = r3.view
    assert(v3 == fallback)

    // 4. Non-finite IEEE-754 +Inf (0x7f800000 = 2139095040) in zoom_bits
    let mut inf_zoom: PersistedView = fallback
    inf_zoom.zoom_bits = 0x7f800000
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(inf_zoom, bounds))
    let r4: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(inf_zoom, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r4.valid)
    let v4: PersistedView = r4.view
    assert(v4 == fallback)

    let mut fractional_resolution = fallback
    fractional_resolution.res_bits = 0x3fc00000 // 1.5 pixels
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(fractional_resolution, bounds))

    // 5. Out-of-range center_x_w0 (2.0 = 0x40000000 > CENTER_X_MAX = 1.0)
    let mut oor_cx: PersistedView = fallback
    oor_cx.center_x.w0 = 0x40000000
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(oor_cx, bounds))
    let r5: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(oor_cx, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r5.valid)
    let v5: PersistedView = r5.view
    assert(v5 == fallback)

    // 6. Out-of-range zoom (4.0 = 0x40800000 > ZOOM_MAX = 3.0)
    let mut oor_zoom: PersistedView = fallback
    oor_zoom.zoom_bits = 0x40800000
    let r6: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(oor_zoom, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r6.valid)
    let v6: PersistedView = r6.view
    assert(v6 == fallback)

    // 7. Finite-but-huge low expansion word (center_x.w1 = 0.5 = 0x3f000000) violates non-overlapping contract
    let mut non_canonical_w1: PersistedView = fallback
    non_canonical_w1.center_x.w1 = 0x3f000000
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(non_canonical_w1, bounds))
    let r7: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(non_canonical_w1, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r7.valid)
    let v7: PersistedView = r7.view
    assert(v7 == fallback)

    // 8. Non-zero w2 when w1 == 0.0 violates canonical expansion contract
    let mut non_canonical_w2: PersistedView = fallback
    non_canonical_w2.center_x.w1 = 0
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(non_canonical_w2, bounds))
    let r8: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(non_canonical_w2, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r8.valid)
    let v8: PersistedView = r8.view
    assert(v8 == fallback)

    // 9. Boundary violation at w0 == CENTER_X_MAX (1.0 = 0x3f800000) with positive non-overlapping w1 (0x33271301)
    let mut boundary_overflow: PersistedView = fallback
    boundary_overflow.center_x = QuadWordBits {
        w0: F32_ONE_BITS,
        w1: 0x33271301,
        w2: 0,
        w3: 0,
    }
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(boundary_overflow, bounds))
    let r9: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(boundary_overflow, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r9.valid)
    let v9: PersistedView = r9.view
    assert(v9 == fallback)
}

            w3: 0x9891c941,
        },
        zoom_bits: 0x33271301,
        res_bits: F32_RES_512_BITS,
        antialias_bits: F32_ONE_BITS,
    }
    let mut persisted: PersistedView = fallback
    persisted.res_bits = F32_RES_1024_BITS
    persisted.center_y.w3 = F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS
    persisted.antialias_bits = F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS
    assert(persisted.center_y.w3 == F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS)
    assert(persisted.center_y.w3 != 0)
    assert(persisted.encoded_byte(67) == 56) // '8' from "80000000"
    assert(is_valid_persisted_view(persisted, bounds))

    let decoded: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(persisted, fallback, bounds)
    assert(decoded.valid)
    let decoded_view: PersistedView = decoded.view
    assert(decoded_view == persisted)
    assert(decoded_view.center_y.w3 == F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS)
    assert(decoded_view.antialias_bits == F32_NEG_ZERO_BITS)

    // Verify +0.0 (00000000) and -0.0 (80000000) remain distinct bit patterns after roundtrip
    let mut pos_zero_view: PersistedView = persisted
    pos_zero_view.center_y.w3 = 0
    let pos_decoded: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(pos_zero_view, fallback, bounds)
    assert(pos_decoded.valid)
    let pos_view: PersistedView = pos_decoded.view
    assert(pos_view == pos_zero_view)
    assert(pos_view != decoded_view)

    // Verify uppercase hex character ('B' = 66 at offset 4) decodes identically to canonical lowercase
    let upper_decoded: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_with_mutated_byte(
        persisted,
        4,
        66,
        URL_ENCODED_LEN,
        fallback,
        bounds,
    )
    assert(upper_decoded.valid)
    let upper_view: PersistedView = upper_decoded.view
    assert(upper_view == persisted)
}

#[test]
fn url_persisted_view_rejects_malformed_nonfinite_and_out_of_range_atomically() {
    let bounds = PersistedBounds {
        center_x_min_bits: 0xc0200000,
        center_x_max_bits: 0x3f800000,
        center_y_min_bits: 0xbfc00000,
        center_y_max_bits: 0x3fc00000,
        zoom_min_bits: 0x129e74d2,
        zoom_max_bits: 0x40400000,
    }
    let fallback = PersistedView {
        center_x: QuadWordBits {
            w0: 0xbf960edd,
            w1: 0xb214a970,
            w2: 0x253e3631,
            w3: 0x17a3a810,
        },
        center_y: QuadWordBits {
            w0: 0x3e97762f,
            w1: 0xb1928121,
            w2: 0xa57b5246,
            w3: 0x9891c941,
        },
        zoom_bits: 0x33271301,
        res_bits: F32_RES_512_BITS,
        antialias_bits: F32_ONE_BITS,
    }
    assert(is_valid_persisted_view(fallback, bounds))

    // 1. Wrong version (#v2:)
    let r1: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_with_mutated_byte(
        fallback,
        2,
        50,
        URL_ENCODED_LEN,
        fallback,
        bounds,
    )
    assert(!r1.valid)
    let v1: PersistedView = r1.view
    assert(v1 == fallback)

    // 2. Malformed hex character ('g' = 103)
    let r2: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_with_mutated_byte(
        fallback,
        10,
        103,
        URL_ENCODED_LEN,
        fallback,
        bounds,
    )
    assert(!r2.valid)
    let v2: PersistedView = r2.view
    assert(v2 == fallback)

    // 3. Truncated length (101 instead of 102)
    let r3: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_with_mutated_byte(
        fallback,
        200,
        0,
        101,
        fallback,
        bounds,
    )
    assert(!r3.valid)
    let v3: PersistedView = r3.view
    assert(v3 == fallback)

    // 4. Non-finite IEEE-754 +Inf (0x7f800000 = 2139095040) in zoom_bits
    let mut inf_zoom: PersistedView = fallback
    inf_zoom.zoom_bits = 0x7f800000
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(inf_zoom, bounds))
    let r4: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(inf_zoom, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r4.valid)
    let v4: PersistedView = r4.view
    assert(v4 == fallback)

    let mut fractional_resolution = fallback
    fractional_resolution.res_bits = 0x3fc00000 // 1.5 pixels
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(fractional_resolution, bounds))

    // 5. Out-of-range center_x_w0 (2.0 = 0x40000000 > CENTER_X_MAX = 1.0)
    let mut oor_cx: PersistedView = fallback
    oor_cx.center_x.w0 = 0x40000000
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(oor_cx, bounds))
    let r5: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(oor_cx, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r5.valid)
    let v5: PersistedView = r5.view
    assert(v5 == fallback)

    // 6. Out-of-range zoom (4.0 = 0x40800000 > ZOOM_MAX = 3.0)
    let mut oor_zoom: PersistedView = fallback
    oor_zoom.zoom_bits = 0x40800000
    let r6: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(oor_zoom, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r6.valid)
    let v6: PersistedView = r6.view
    assert(v6 == fallback)

    // 7. Finite-but-huge low expansion word (center_x.w1 = 0.5 = 0x3f000000) violates non-overlapping contract
    let mut non_canonical_w1: PersistedView = fallback
    non_canonical_w1.center_x.w1 = 0x3f000000
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(non_canonical_w1, bounds))
    let r7: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(non_canonical_w1, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r7.valid)
    let v7: PersistedView = r7.view
    assert(v7 == fallback)

    // 8. Non-zero w2 when w1 == 0.0 violates canonical expansion contract
    let mut non_canonical_w2: PersistedView = fallback
    non_canonical_w2.center_x.w1 = 0
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(non_canonical_w2, bounds))
    let r8: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(non_canonical_w2, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r8.valid)
    let v8: PersistedView = r8.view
    assert(v8 == fallback)

    // 9. Boundary violation at w0 == CENTER_X_MAX (1.0 = 0x3f800000) with positive non-overlapping w1 (0x33271301)
    let mut boundary_overflow: PersistedView = fallback
    boundary_overflow.center_x = QuadWordBits {
        w0: F32_ONE_BITS,
        w1: 0x33271301,
        w2: 0,
        w3: 0,
    }
    assert(!is_valid_persisted_view(boundary_overflow, bounds))
    let r9: DecodedPersistedView = roundtrip_persisted_view(boundary_overflow, fallback, bounds)
    assert(!r9.valid)
    let v9: PersistedView = r9.view
    assert(v9 == fallback)
}
